title: God speaks without bodily members
english: God speaks to humans in the Scriptures. Some invent a bodily God; philosophers mock it as fable. We confess God [[bodiless and invisible >> Bible:1 Timothy 1:17]], and yet that he cares for mortal things, and that [[nothing is done apart from his providence >> Bible:Matthew 10:29]].
translator_notes: Homilia III CLOSEOUT after Homilia II dfcb3f46.

title: Providence and will; why Scripture says God speaks
english: Many things happen without God’s will; nothing without his providence. God shows what he wills by an affect humans know — so he is said to have spoken. Not a bodily mouth, but a will shaped into words in an illuminated mind.
translator_notes: Homilia III CLOSEOUT after Homilia II dfcb3f46.

title: Abram and Abraham — name-change before the covenant
english: Oracles to Abram and to Abraham differ. Before the name-change: [[Go out from your land >> Bible:Genesis 12:1]] — not yet circumcision. After he went out: Abraham, the covenant and circumcision. The fleshly name could not yet bear God’s covenant.
translator_notes: Homilia III CLOSEOUT after Homilia II dfcb3f46.

title: Circumcision of flesh and of heart
english: Circumcision is the covenant’s sign in the flesh; its meaning is the cutting away of vices. Not skin alone — the heart must be circumcised. Paul: [[circumcision of the heart in the Spirit, not the letter >> Bible:Romans 2:29]].
translator_notes: Homilia III CLOSEOUT after Homilia II dfcb3f46.

title: Eighth day and aged faith
english: The [[eighth day >> Bible:Genesis 17:12]] is a mystery of resurrection and of the age to come. Grace forestalls the infant. Abraham at a hundred: faith makes aging nature live.
translator_notes: Homilia III CLOSEOUT after Homilia II dfcb3f46.

title: House-born and bought with a price
english: [[Every male of the household and every purchased servant is to be circumcised >> Bible:Genesis 17:12-13]]. House-members of the church and those [[bought with Christ’s price >> Bible:1 Corinthians 6:20]] are sealed with one sign.
translator_notes: Homilia III CLOSEOUT after Homilia II dfcb3f46.

title: New names — Homilia III CLOSEOUT
english: Souls that have changed name — Abram into Abraham, Sarai into Sarah — rejoice in the covenant of new generation. This is Homily III’s close. Amen.
translator_notes: Homilia III CLOSEOUT after Homilia II dfcb3f46.
